claims.statement: Tom Allen arrived in New Orleans with a large St. Louis delegation for the coming fights.
claims.excerpt: A large delegation from St. Louis arrived to-night, including Billy Johnson, Ed Butler, Chris Krauss, Constable Ben hee g & Harry Harris of the Morgan Club, Tom Kelly and Tom Allen

claims.statement: Tom Allen was very positive that John L. Sullivan would win.
claims.excerpt: Tom Allen is very positive that Sulliyan will win, sois Watkins.

claims.statement: Fred Watkins, Allen's old backer, was in the St. Louis delegation at New Orleans.
